messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for service=redwood-inference-api, severity=page, region=us-west-2. Symptoms: increased 5xx rate and latency spikes. Pager runbook: https://runbooks.internal/inf-api-pager 

oncall_ryan: ack  - jumping in. current local: 09:15 PT.

sara: Thanks @oncall_ryan. Assigning incident owner: @sara (coord) until handoff. Can you post a war room link and quick triage? :white_check_mark:

ops_lead: War room: https://meet.internal/warroom/1789678901 — mic open. Posting bridge + recording enabled.

eng_sre_anna: saw the alert. Initial check: tailing logs shows surge from model-host pool-3 causing OOM retries -> upstream 502s. Rolling back last config deploy? last deploy id: dpl-2026-03-17-04.

oncall_ryan: currently running health-check script and looking at node metrics. snippet: `kubectl top pods -l app=inference --namespace=prod` shows memory climb on pool-3 by ~30% over baseline.

support_liz: Customer impact: a subset of API keys are seeing 5xx errors and streaming timeouts. Tentative customer list: enterprise-3, aichat-pro sandbox. We should draft statuspage text now.

jamal: +1 on status page. Suggested customer-facing blurb (short):
```
We are investigating an issue affecting text-generation API in the US-West region. Some requests may see elevated errors or delays. Our team is actively mitigating and will provide updates within 30 minutes.
```

sara: I edited that slightly for tone and added ETA line:
```
We are investigating an issue affecting the Redwood inference API in US-West. Some requests may return errors or experience high latency. Engineers are rolling back a recent config and validating nodes. Next update by 09:45 PT.
```

ops_lead: Good. @support_liz can you publish as a "degraded performance" incident on statusboard? Use component: inference-api-us-west. Mark impacted: Partial.

support_liz: Publishing now. Drafting email to affected customers to prep support teams.

eng_sre_anna: Quick mitigation: scaling down pool-3 to 60% and draining new work while we revert the deployment flag `enable_kv_prefetch=true`. If rollback succeeds, we should see 5xxs drop. Pushing revert now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=20260317-03`

oncall_ryan: Revert started. I'll watch error rate and latency dashboards. Please call if errors don't drop in 5 min.

incident-bot: Action logged: owner=sara, status=in-progress, incident_id=INC-1789678901. Pager acknowledged by oncall_ryan.

jamal: FYI for handoff: if we can't stabilize within 60m escalate to Eng SRE lead @ops_lead and prepare customer postmortem template.

sara: Copy. Handoff protocol: if stable at 09:40 PT we mark as "mitigated" and hand to SRE for review. If regressions at any point, re-page.

ops_lead: All right team — keep messages short in this channel, use war room for deep debugging. I'll coordinate customer comms cadence. :rocket:

support_liz: Posted statuspage and sent initial notifications to affected customer contacts. I'll update with the next status at 09:45 PT.

oncall_ryan: Monitoring — errors trending down after revert, tailing logs show fewer OOMs. Will confirm in 2-3 minutes.

eng_sre_anna: Looks good so far. If stable for 10 minutes we can re-enable kv_prefetch with conservative ramp.

sara: Thanks everyone — logging this thread into the incident doc and attaching war room notes. Keeping short updates here.
